landing.tagline: A kanban that does not get in the way
landing.headline: The board that does not get in the way
landing.lead: A lightweight kanban for teams of up to 15: fast start, keyboard-first, offline, and real-time collaboration.
landing.demoHint: Drag a card — this is an interactive demo, no signup required.
landing.featuresSubtitle: Minimum chrome, maximum work. Everything important on one screen.
landing.feature1Text: N for a new card, Space to pick up, arrows to move. A mouse is optional.
landing.feature2Text: Edits are stored on your device and leave on their own once the network is back.
landing.feature3Text: Changes appear in milliseconds, presence shows who is on the board.
landing.pricingSubtitle: Start for free. Pay only when you need more.
landing.faq1A: Yes. The board opens from a local cache, changes queue up and synchronise automatically.
landing.faq2Q: Do I need to install anything?
landing.faq2A: No. Kanban is a PWA: it runs in the browser and can be added to your home screen.
landing.faq3A: Yes, a board exports to JSON, CSV and Markdown in one click.
landing.faq4A: Only members of your workspace. All permission checks happen on the server.

about.title: A kanban board that does not get in the way
about.lead: Kanban is a lightweight board for teams of up to 15 people. Fast start, keyboard-first control, offline mode and real-time syncing of changes between participants.
about.whyText: Most task trackers grow into heavy platforms with dozens of settings. This project is the opposite: one clear board, quick actions and nothing that distracts from the work. The goal is a tool you can open, understand and start using in a minute.
about.whoText: Small product teams, studios, agencies and freelancers: people who need shared tasks, clear statuses and honest collaboration without a week of onboarding.
about.featuresSubtitle: The full feature set described in the technical specification.
about.feature1Text: Drag and drop, WIP limits, labels, assignees, deadlines, checklists, attachments, comments and mentions.
about.feature2Text: A Durable Object per board streams events, shows presence and lets a reconnecting client catch up from the last sequence number.
about.feature3Text: IndexedDB keeps a board snapshot and a queue of mutations, so edits survive a dropped connection and leave on their own once the network is back.
about.feature4Text: FTS5 search across titles, descriptions and comments, saved filters, a list view and a personal My tasks feed.
about.feature5Text: Workspace roles, invitations, global and local bans, an audit log, active sessions and Google OAuth as the only sign-in method.
about.feature6Text: Light, dark and system themes, RU/EN, a command palette, keyboard shortcuts and ARIA-friendly components.
about.stackText: The front end is a React single-page app, the back end is a Cloudflare Worker. A shared package holds the Zod schemas, types and utilities used by both sides.
about.stackWeb: React 19, Vite, TanStack Router and Query, dnd-kit, Dexie
about.stackApi: Cloudflare Workers, Hono, D1, KV, Durable Objects
about.stackDeploy: GitHub Pages for the web app, Workers for the API, GitHub Actions for CI/CD
about.authorRole: Author of the 5D service, BIM developer
about.authorBio: BIM developer and author of the 5D service, a web app that connects a Revit 3D model with the work schedule and cost. This kanban follows the same idea: clear data, a simple interface and real work instead of settings.
